exposure: duration of the second stage of labor >60 minutes
cohort: The study included 398 women receiving delivery services at Arba Minch General Hospital.
finding: The magnitude of spontaneous perineal tears was 37.4%, and applying fundal pressure, female genital cutting scar, no mediolateral episiotomy, duration of the second stage of labor >60 minutes, assisted vaginal delivery, no perineal support, and birth weight >3500 grams were significantly associated factors.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was associated with spontaneous perineal tears (AOR = 4.27; 95% CI = 1.21-15.01).
birth_weight: >3500 grams was identified as an associated factor
